correctness.rationale: All n>=6 have a cyclic ±/0 face model. Two-sign faces omit at least two cyclic edges; every top simplex is a facet of an embedded pure-sign boundary sphere, and the integral top boundary kernel is exactly Z^2 on these two sphere classes. Published arXiv:2601.05670v1 provides connectivity and one lower free homology group. Hurewicz gives lower spherical representatives (including n divisible by four, where extra vanishing upgrades connectivity). Their wedge with the two embedded top spheres is a simply-connected CW homology equivalence, hence a homotopy equivalence by Whitehead. No infinite claim rests on finite enumeration.
